patent.title: Vacuum cleaner
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-14 (international R0). Do not map via Henry brand fame alone; require public EP3934499→SKU chart.

knowledge_origin.description: Numatic International Ltd assignee; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Reduce operator exposure to dust when emptying / replacing a vacuum filter bag or cartridge.
technology.mechanism: Cylindrical vacuum chamber housing a gas-porous filter cartridge; chamber configurable open/closed; in open config an end-cap at the nozzle end is displaced so the cartridge can be removed (preferably under gravity) without gripping the dirty membrane.

value_carriers.name: Numatic Henry / Hetty cylinder vacuum product line (candidate; multi-SKU)
value_carriers.description: Same assignee brand. Public Henry = canister with HepaFlo bags / TriTex; no EP3934499 named and architecture ≠ claim-1 end-cap cartridge chamber. Claims check FAIL.

gaps.description: No public evidence naming EP3934499 on a commercial Henry (or other) SKU with a claims chart to end-cap cartridge chamber.
needed_evidence: Claims chart to commercial handheld SKU

notes: Holdout INT-14. T0=2026-10-13. Claims FAIL → R0. Henry product narrative ≠ this grant. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
